name: loopbudget
description: Check a loop against its musical length and boundary continuity.
title: BETA · BPM-aware seam audit
limit: Measured seam jumps and slope differences do not prove audibility. No repair or tempo detection.

name: tailbudget
description: Find the last sample above a threshold and budget how much quiet tail to keep.
title: BETA · Tail trimming with an explicit keep budget
limit: Uses sample amplitude, not a perceptual reverb detector. Pad keeps existing silence; it does not append silence. An all-quiet input retains at least one frame.

name: monoledger
description: Locate active stereo windows that lose energy when folded to mono.
title: BETA · Time-coded mono cancellation ledger
limit: Requires stereo. Loss is measured against average channel energy. Silent windows are ignored; correlation is null for constant channels.

name: gapcontext
description: Find interior quiet runs bordered by active audio, with context energy attached.
title: BETA · Silence candidates with active flanks
limit: Candidates can be musical rests. No automatic deletion, interpolation or diagnosis of recording failure.

name: railruns
description: Map consecutive near-full-scale samples by channel instead of reporting only a peak.
title: BETA · Clipping threshold event ledger
limit: Detects threshold runs, not analog clipping or true peaks. Single transient peaks can be excluded by the run length.

name: dcjourney
description: Measure DC offset over time and distinguish local drift from the whole-file mean.
title: BETA · Windowed DC offset history
limit: Global mean removal does not correct time-varying drift. Asymmetric audio can legitimately have nonzero local means. Export refuses samples above full scale.

name: gainbudget
description: Calculate a gain budget before changing audio and show which channels set the limit.
title: BETA · Requested gain versus sample peak ceiling
limit: Sample peak only, not true peak or LUFS. No limiter. No guarantee against intersample peaks. Export is 16-bit.

name: stemcontract
description: Check exported files against an explicit rate, channel, length and filename contract.
title: BETA · Repeatable stem delivery contract
limit: Checks export structure and activity, not phase alignment or correctness of the music. Expected basenames are exact and case sensitive. Extra filenames are allowed.

name: cueclock
description: Generate a musical cue grid rounded independently to exact audio frames.
title: BETA · Sample-accurate bar clock
limit: Constant quarter-note BPM supplied by user. No tempo estimation, beat detection or tempo maps. Offset is a new bar 1 origin. No endpoint cue.

name: renderdelta
description: Compare two renders at a supplied sample offset and report changed sections.
title: BETA · Offset-aware residual timeline
limit: No automatic alignment or gain matching. A null does not imply perceptual equivalence; reports are sample differences. Unmatched frames are counted, not compared. Residual export refuses levels above full scale.
